text.en:
1. (1) The following persons shall be disqualified from being appointed
or being members of the Council—

(a) a person who is of unsound mind or is otherwise incapable
of performing his duties;

(b) a bankrupt;

(c) a person who has been convicted of an offence and sentenced
to imprisonment for a term of not less than one year.

(2) A member of the Council shall vacate his office if he fails to
attend three consecutive meetings of the Council without the permission
in writing of the Minister or if he becomes disqualified under sub-
paragraph (1),

2. (1) The quorum of the Council shall be nine.

(2) If on any question to be determined by the Council there is an
equality of votes, the Chairman or other member acting as Chairman
shall have a casting vote.

(3) Subject to sub-paragraphs (1) and (2), the Council shall deter-
mine its own procedure.

(4) The seal of the Council shall be authenticated by the Chairman,
or other member acting as Chairman, and one other member of the
Council, and any document purporting to be sealed with the said seal,
authenticated as aforesaid, shall until the contrary is shown be deemed
to have been validly executed.

3. A member of the Council having any interest in any company or
undertaking with which the Council proposes to make any contract or
having any interest in any such contract or in any matter under
discussion by the Council shall disclose to the Council the fact of
his interest and the nature thereof, and such disclosure shall be recorded
in the minutes of the Council, and unless specifically authorised thereto
by the Chairman, the member shall take no part in any deliberation
or decision of the Council relating to the contract.

[Received the Royal Assent
on the 9th day of
February, 1966.]
